baseline.description: Earlier-only beta-smoothed batter hit rate combined with an earlier-only batting-slot PA-count distribution; an explicit independent-PA benchmark, never substituted for V18 paths
baseline.name: PREGAME_PLAYER_RATE_PLUS_SLOT_EXPOSURE_BASELINE_V1

capture.eligibleForecast: Immutable V18 forecast with complete confirmed nine-player lineups, two named starters, 5000 draws, target-excluding frozen model, and every source/lineup/starter clock before forecast creation and first pitch
capture.ownerIntegration: Inactive hook after the existing V18 owner commits an immutable eligible forecast and before scheduled start; no new scheduler
capture.sidecarRule: Generate or retain the passive per-draw sidecar before scheduled start; deterministic postgame derivation is diagnostic only

chronologicalRoles.development: First consecutive game-date blocks after activation until every family-specific minimum is met; no Validation outcomes may be read
chronologicalRoles.validation: Next consecutive game-date blocks, fixed only after Development method/calibrator is frozen

exclusions.cancelledPostponedAbandoned: Exclude with immutable disposition; never score or infer void mass
exclusions.lateScratchOrDifferentStarter: Exclude as settlement-ineligible because participation/void is not modeled
exclusions.shortenedGame: Include only if official final and a predeclared compatible full-game settlement rule applies; otherwise exclude
exclusions.startingBatterSubstitution: Keep the starter's official full-game player total and report substitution exposure; never supply actual substitution to simulation
